title: Smirnov's local-to-global metrization theorem
authors: Ruy Jose Guerra Barretto de Queiroz
summary: A space is metrizable if and only if it is Hausdorff, paracompact and locally metrizable. A reusable construction gives a sigma locally finite basis from any point-finite open cover of metrizable patches in a paracompact space, without a separation hypothesis. Local neighborhoods, the cover index and each basis layer may have arbitrary cardinality. The proof assumes no second countability, separability, local compactness or nonemptiness. Classical mathematics; no novelty or priority claim.

formalizes.title: Geometric Aspects of General Topology, second-edition author manuscript (November 2, 2023)

review.reason: Constructs a local-to-global metrization theorem for paracompact Hausdorff spaces without extra separation hypotheses.
